name: multispeciality-hms
description: Enterprise Multispeciality Hospital Management System for Kizuna Multispeciality Hospitals
author: Kizuna Engineering Team

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/contracts build && pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/validation build && pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/api-client build && pnpm -r --filter=!@multispeciality-hms/mobile build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/contracts build && pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/validation build && pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/config build && pnpm --filter @multispeciality-hms/api-client build
